provenance: SYNTHETIC one-product controller; no camera image or storage
pointing_requirement: Both Basilisk MRP tracking tolerance and angular rate tolerance from adcs_01/config.json
independent_verification: Recompute actual sensor boresight-target LOS using spacecraft attitude and Ground position; verify all capture samples
limitations: The product contains no pixels; it is a modeled data volume
A command is one simulated tick, not a camera optical exposure
No reaction wheels, pointing sensor noise, onboard storage or radio delivery
The target is always being tracked even outside geometric access
Simulated Earth coordinates are not linked to UTC
